entities.name: Slogurk
entities.description: An Ooze from Innistrad that lurks in the swamps of Morkrut and destroys ships.

entities.name: Morkrut
entities.description: Swamps on Innistrad where Slogurk lurks.

events.summary: Slogurk condenses its essence under a ship, rises and smashes it, then its maws meet sailors who jump overboard.
events.quote: It condenses its essence under the boat and rises from the water, smashing it to pieces.

relations.note: Lurks deep within the swamps of Morkrut.
relations.quote: A monster lurks deep within the swamps of Morkrut.
